meta.title: statica — Just HTML.
meta.description: statica is Just HTML. A blazingly fast static site generator that builds on just HTML.

hero.body: statica is a blazingly fast static site generator that builds on just HTML. Your source is HTML. Your output is HTML. Everything in between is build time.

idea.title: The web already has a language.
idea.lead: Static site generators keep inventing another one. statica doesn’t.
idea.body: Use HTML for structure, CSS for style, JavaScript for behavior, and structured data when you need to generate content. statica handles the build, then gets out of the way.

how.title: HTML in. HTML out.
how.author_body: Write valid HTML. Link data and fragments only where you need them.
how.ship_body: Deploy plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript anywhere static files can live.

features.title: Enough power to build real sites.
features.body: These cards are generated from the active i18n catalog and rendered through one reusable statica fragment.

platform.title: If the web can do it, your statica site can do it.
platform.body: statica does not impose a frontend runtime. Build an interactive API explorer from OpenAPI JSON, documentation, catalogs, dashboards, or a tiny five-page site. At runtime, it is simply the web platform.

install.title: Your next site can just be a website.
install.body: Choose your install path, create a site, then run statica watch.

feature_items.title: Data-driven HTML
feature_items.body: Link JSON, JSONL, CSV, Markdown, text, or globs as build-time data. No runtime content fetch required.

feature_items.title: Filesystem generation
feature_items.body: Turn folders like [slug], [page], and [locale] into generated routes while keeping every source page valid HTML.

feature_items.title: Reusable HTML
feature_items.body: Compose build-time fragments with template and slot. Scope their CSS and JavaScript without adding a client component runtime.

feature_items.title: Built-in processing
feature_items.body: Process HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images, and fonts with statica's native pipeline instead of assembling another toolchain.

feature_items.title: Site features included
feature_items.body: Pagination, i18n, RSS, sitemaps, static 404s, and forms are available when the site needs them.

feature_items.title: Fast builds
feature_items.body: Incremental watch mode, configurable parallel rendering, build reports, and a single native CLI keep the loop tight.

install_items.label: Homebrew
install_items.command: brew tap akaizn-junior/statica && brew install statica
